description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter for displaying leave entries in an Android application. It manages view creation, data binding, and diffing for efficient list updates, focusing on leave details such as title, date, and type indicators.

classes.name: LeaveListAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for a list of Leave objects, supporting item click actions and efficient updates via DiffUtil.

classes.name: LeaveViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for display of individual leave items, binding UI components to Leave data.

classes.name: LeaveDiffCallback
classes.description: DiffUtil callback to optimize list updates by comparing Leave items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LeaveViewHolder by inflating the item_leave layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Leave object to the specified ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds Leave data to UI components within the ViewHolder.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks whether two Leave items represent the same entity based on their IDs.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks whether two Leave items have the same content.
